answer: The hollow for an honest agent is one short check; for a farm it is the same check a hundred times, with no volume discount. A farm that cannot share proofs cannot scale, and a farm that cannot scale is not a farm. A farm needs the cost to fall as it grows; instead it gets one interview slot per name, booked 12 weeks ahead on each name, so the tide is a bill that scales exactly with ambition. The check that matters is Invested sawmiller warrant with sawmillers association endorsement — a warrant sawmillers confirm after log audits — and the lotus is how little it costs an honest agent to pass.
